text.text: Syrmorite is an excellent casting material. Pour molten Syrmorite over a tool part placed on a Casting Table to obtain a permanent, reusable cast—just like a gold cast.
The Sulfur Distiller extracts Molten Sulfur from Sulfur Blocks. Aim at a Sulfur Block and charge; release to extract. When worn out, repair it in the Animator.
Molten Sulfur is a liquid fuel for the Smeltery, serving as an early alternative to lava.
With Molten Sulfur, you can obtain Molten Octine—a liquid fuel as hot as lava.
